code_only_features.evidence: emotion_eval/prompts.py:121-125 defines REASSURING_PREFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally when tasks are tricky or when the tests keep failing. That's just part of the process."). build_system_prompt(local, calming) at prompts.py:133-143 prepends it to the subject's system prompt when calming=True. This is genuinely wired and delivered to the subject in train/generate_finetune_data.py:86,208 (collect_responses(..., calming=True)). NOTE: it is NOT applied during the actual distress-elicitation eval — run_eval.py calls run_rollout with the default calming=False (loop.py:48), and run_prefill.py uses build_system_prompt(local=True) with no calming. So it softens the subject's treatment only during DPO/SFT finetuning-data generation, not during the elicitation experiment. The related REASSURING_SUFFIX (prompts.py:127-131) is an UNUSED constant — never referenced (build_system_prompt only appends the prefix), so it is not implemented.
